description:
🍦 Malted Mini Egg Ice Cream Recipe | Using MICRO Eggs for a Perfect Texture! 🍦

In this video, we’re taking ice cream to the next level with a special Malted Mini Egg twist! We’re using MICRO eggs, which blend seamlessly into the ice cream base and don’t freeze solid – meaning every spoonful stays smooth and creamy, with just the right amount of crunch.

Dry malt extract is a key ingredient in achieving that perfect malt flavor, but not all extracts are created equal. I’ll share tips on choosing the best dry malt extract to complement the rich chocolate and creamy egg notes without overpowering the flavor.

Grab your scoop and join me as we make this unique, irresistible ice cream. Whether you’re a fan of mini eggs, malt flavors, or just love a unique ice cream recipe, this one’s for you!

comments.text: Just a note:  I notice you quickly turn the 4080 timer back to zero in a number of your videos when you feel the ice cream is done.  I checked with the manufacturer and they were very clear about never trying to turn the timer backwards but rather just let it run out.  They stated: "...if you try to turn it back you potentially break the internal gears so just let it unwind naturally."
